scope: Prophet Paper design migration to the established shared shell; no Beta source code, deployment, runtime lifecycle, economic validation or production acceptance change.

pages.name: 00 · START HERE · Shared shell handoff
pages.description: Current integration contract, coverage, exact limits and source receipts.

pages.name: 01 · Workspace · Shared shell
pages.description: Flagship Today, setup, evidence, screener, compare, plans, record and source-health screens. The mobile Plans body hold is explicit.

pages.name: 02 · Sector connection · Shared shell
pages.description: Market → sector → company journeys. SX09–SX12 are state/disclosure/build references; preserve the evaluation definitions.

pages.name: 03 · Opportunities · Shared shell refs
pages.description: R7/R8 opportunities, lenses, setup, comparison and saved-list flows. The held ZE5-0 reference is excluded from extraction.

pages.name: 04 · Rich cards · Shared shell refs
pages.description: Complete-card, strategy and mobile journeys. Keep identity, quote, chart, release, cautions, entry terms and return context.

pages.name: 04a · Expanded desktop · Opportunities
pages.description: Expanded desktop cards, comparison, early leadership and the no-entry state. Larger boards are separated from compact examples to prevent overlap.

pages.name: 05 · Daily brief & recovery · Shared shell
pages.description: Daily brief, change history, comparisons, first-failure and history-unknown recovery. Retain each independent clock.

pages.name: 06 · Today, setup & plans · Shared shell
pages.description: R2 Today, setup and model-plan behavior, tablets, mobile and plan-guide examples.

pages.name: 07 · Screener & compare · Shared shell
pages.description: Table, grid and comparison designs. All columns remain; narrow views use the existing compact specimens.

pages.name: 08 · Hong Kong & Canada · Shared shell
pages.description: 18 visible regional variants in English/Chinese and light/dark at 1440, 390 and 320. The hidden superseded Canada board stays excluded.

pages.name: 09 · Evidence & playbooks · Shared shell
pages.description: Evidence, source details, playbooks, independent quote/assessment clocks and return paths. Larger desktop reviews continue on 10a.

pages.name: 10 · Quote & assessment · Shared shell
pages.description: Fresh, stale, failed and unchanged-assessment states. The expanded failed-refresh desktop is on 10a.

pages.name: 10a · Expanded desktop · Reviews
pages.description: Expanded failed-refresh, setup/timing and playbook desktop layouts; source definitions and chart geometry are preserved.

pages.name: 11 · Build contracts & compact states
pages.description: D03 compact screens use the shared header. Internal contracts and state atlases remain documentation; this current shell contract supersedes provisional geometry.

pages.name: 12 · Shared contracts & state coverage
pages.description: Behavior, coverage, overlays and degraded-state references. Mount component specimens inside the existing shell route.

pages.name: 13 · Build · Clarity preservation
pages.description: Preservation rules for meaningful content and research depth. Internal build documentation is excluded from product extraction.

pages.name: 14 · Component studies · Host contract
pages.description: Isolated card studies. Mount them in the Prophet content region beneath local context; do not manufacture a separate global shell for a component.

pages.name: ARCHIVE · Rejected directions · Do not build
pages.description: Retained rejected directions, for historical comparison only. Use the current workspace and complete-card references.

pages.name: SOURCE · Historical capture · Do not build
pages.description: The original live-baseline capture is preserved as source evidence. It is not a current shared-shell implementation target.
